Seeded sample of 15 targets computed in the adversarial table; 11 locators checked against bauer-pauly-schomburg, meyers-1963, tao-dispersive, krylov-vmo, armstrong-kempe; the books (Evans, Gilbarg-Trudinger, Stein, Grafakos and others) not verifiable. Gate passes (all checks 0); depcheck 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning (19); one-tactic probe closes none; both repair statements of R01 elaborate.
